name: @budcom/desktop
description: Business OS Tally Connector — Windows desktop shell

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && tsc -p tsconfig.main.json && node scripts/copy-renderer-assets.mjs && node ../../scripts/release/generate-build-info.mjs dist/main/build-info.json
scripts.lint: tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.preload.json --noEmit && vitest run --passWithNoTests false
scripts.dist:win: npm run build --prefix ../../connector/budcom_connector && npm run build && node ../../scripts/release/prepare-connector-packaging.mjs && node ../../scripts/release/prepare-node-runtime.mjs && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml
